actions.name: Create PR
actions.prompt: first run('make absorb-sgai'); store the git path (by querying jj git root) into the environment variable GIT_DIR, and using GH, make a draft PR for the commit at @ (jj); CRITICAL: commit message, the PR title and body, must adhere to the standard of previous commits - update all of these if necessary; once you are done, using bash(`open`), open the PR for me. REMEMBER: 'GOALS' must never be the used commit message or PR title prefix; when the PR already exists, make sure you update its body and title with the latest updates; store the PR information (like URL) into .sgai/PR_INFO
actions.description: Create a draft pull request from current changes

actions.name: React to PR Review
actions.prompt: store the git path (by querying jj) into GIT_DIR, and using gh, react to the current PR review using the same base PR context as Create PR; use gh to inspect the existing PR and review feedback, prepare the appropriate response or updates, fix issues that have been called out (and mark them as resolved), and apply the reaction through gh; update any PR metadata if needed, and store the PR information (like URL) into .sgai/PR_INFO; remember to jj git push in a way to update the current active PR
actions.description: React to the current PR review with gh

actions.name: Upstream Sync
actions.prompt: `jj git fetch --all-remotes`; rebase against main@origin (`jj rebase -d main@origin`), fix merge conflicts, and push (make sure you push onto the branch of the PR, if a PR already exists for this workspace)
actions.description: Fetch and rebase against upstream main branch

actions.name: Deleted Unused Branches
actions.prompt: store the git path (by querying jj) into GIT_DIR, and using gh, find all branches that have already been merged or have been unused for more than 1 week and delete them
